src: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query Dump (file PDQ_DSV.zip, share https://mft.rrc.texas.gov/link/1f5ddb8d-329a-4459-b7f8-177b4f5ee60d, listed at https://www.rrc.texas.gov/resource-center/research/data-sets-available-for-download/, extracted 20-OCT-26, production months 1993-01 to 2026-08). Tables OG_COUNTY_CYCLE (monthly volumes by county; RRC allocates multi-county leases to counties, an estimate per the PDQ manual) and OG_COUNTY_LEASE_CYCLE (distinct leases with production in the latest 12 months). Counties with no production in the 36 months are omitted; offshore areas (codes 600-715, no polygon) are in `offshore` (monthly oil and gas) and the statewide series, so counties + offshore = series-production.json. oil = crude oil (OIL_PROD_VOL) + condensate (COND_PROD_VOL), barrels; gas = gas-well gas (GAS_PROD_VOL) + casinghead gas (CSGD_PROD_VOL), mcf; leases and gas wells both count as leases. Months end at 2026-01, the last month in which RRC statewide crude + condensate is at least 98% of EIA's Texas field production; later months in the dump are still being reported and are left out (statewide figures for them: series-production.json, partial).
